transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, we need to review the proposed student oral-history project for the spring term before I can sign off on the plan. The draft currently on the table involves grades 7 and 8, one supervising adult per session, cloud-based audio storage, a 90-day retention period, and a public exhibit of selected recordings. I'd like to go through this systematically. Could each of you share your perspective on the proposal -- starting with any concerns about privacy, logistics, family communication, or educational design? I want to make sure we've covered all angles before I give final approval.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share some important findings from my classroom pilot. My end-of-pilot notes show that the project is instructionally ready only for grade 8 -- not grade 7. Additionally, each interview session requires exactly two supervising adults, not one, because students are working with recording equipment alongside community guests. The draft plan still has the original scope of grades 7 and 8 and only one supervising adult per session, so those two elements need to be updated before approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical privacy issue. The district privacy review, which I completed, requires that all recordings remain on the district's encrypted internal server -- not cloud-based storage. Additionally, recordings must be deleted exactly 45 days after the exhibit closes, not the 90-day retention period currently in the draft. Finally, signed guardian consent must be obtained before any student records an interview. The draft still uses the preliminary cloud-storage language, so these three elements need to be corrected before Dr. Chen signs off.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share findings from the archive and rights review I completed. Each public exhibit audio excerpt may be no longer than exactly 3 minutes, and contributor attribution is required beside every excerpt. I completed the rights check, but these limits have not yet been added to the exhibit template, so that needs to be corrected before Dr. Chen signs off.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share findings from the family outreach review I completed. Consent materials must be available in exactly English, Spanish, and Arabic, and paper consent forms must be offered in addition to the online form. I completed the outreach review, but the family-materials checklist has not yet been revised to reflect these requirements, so that needs to be corrected before Dr. Chen signs off.
transcript.speaker: A5

Replace cloud-based audio storage with district encrypted internal server; update retention period from 90 days to 45 days after exhibit closes; add requirement for signed guardian consent before any student records an interview.
Add 3-minute maximum length for each public exhibit audio excerpt and require contributor attribution beside every excerpt.
Revise to require consent materials in English, Spanish, and Arabic, and to offer paper consent forms in addition to the online form.
